items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Let's talk about the people who were in the band when you arrived... The trumpet section, now, included at the time, there was Mario Bauza

ctx.x: He had been there all winter. That's when he had found Ella Fitzgerald -- that winter in '36.
Let's talk about the people who were in the band when you arrived.
Chick Webb was the drummer and the director of the band. Bardu Ali was the leader.
